plan: Final experiment design published at stage=result. Structure follows the researcher's A-K skeleton. (A) Title, objective, non-technical summary restated. (B) Five RQs preserved: quality, prefill performance, decode performance, attribution of cost/quality to weight-only/activation/KV-cache/rotation, MHA-vs-GQA scaling between 7B and 13B. (C) Mechanistic background: Hadamard rotations around q/k/v/o and gate/up/down linears and around residual streams; invariance property enabling online K/V rotation; W4A4+K4V4=4-bit as headline cell; LLaMa-2 architecture constants tabulated. (D) Cell matrix: 7 mandatory cells (FP16-UNR as sanity, FP16-ROT as primary control, W4A16-RTN, W4A16-GPTQ, QuaRot W4A16, QuaRot W4A4+K4V4=FP16, QuaRot W4A4+K4V4=4-bit as headline) cross 2 models; all six researcher resolutions baked in. (E) Metrics/methodology: prefill wall-time at L in {512,1024,2048,4096}, decode mean/p50/p95/p99 over N=256, closed-form S_kv distinguishing 7B MHA from 13B GQA, peak memory from layer-wise accounting, analytical cost model parameterized by HBM bandwidth and 4-bit matmul / Hadamard kernel timings extrapolated from QuaRot Table 5 / kernel charts. (F) Profiling strategy: per-phase alpha/beta decomposition tables for C6 covering Hadamard-rotation vs W4A4 GEMM vs KV-cache bandwidth vs attention vs residency, with decode-step-index dynamics explained. (G) Attribution subsection: 4-lever matrix (L1 weight 4-bit, L2 activation 4-bit+rotation, L3 KV 4-bit, L4 rotation overhead) with explicit linear system mapping each cell delta to levers. (H) Controls/confounders: identical calibration data, identical prompts, N=256 greedy decoding with fixed seed, batch=1, contiguous KV cache, single named backend, plus all called-out confounders. (I) Feasibility: 4 inspection + 2 handoff calls used (well under budgets); 7 cells x 2 models mandatory at L=1024; optional extensions (sequence-length sweep, longer-decode p99, 70B); no network/GPU/dependency installation needed for the design. (J) Risk register: (1) extrapolation drift vs deployed kernel, (2) tail-latency sensitivity to bandwidth contention, (3) MHA-vs-GQA scaling assumption (mandatory pre-cross-check against meta-llama config.json); plus minor listed limitations. (K) Cell-by-cell expected-findings table with directional deltas (improves/degrades/neutral) plus one-line justifications, each grounded to a cited QuaRot/LLaMa-2 reference and labeled as extrapolation; falsification criteria listed. Closing note explicitly marks the artifact as design-only and labels every numerical claim as extrapolation or closed-form derivation; no sandbox measurement is claimed.
